listOfIntroStory.text: Once upon a time, amongst rolling green plains and lush river lands there existed a great kingdom called Magnarta.
It was a nation of noble heroes and fair maidens, but above all else, it was the home of the fabled Mystic Knights.
Old tales recount their sudden appearance in the battlefields, wielding steel and flame with equal excellency and forming a pact with the Magnartan kings.
Such tales inpired wonderment in people's hearts, to the point where many a Magnartan youngster dreamed of becoming a Mystic Knight, in the hopes to partake in those glorious feats.
One of these young hopeful was Maya, a girl of tenacious spirit and singular crimson hair, who loved to listen to the tales of the mythical heroes.

Maya loved to escape to the gardens outside and play with the sword and board, fantasizing about woundrous adventures... 

...all the while nagging her uncle to such extent that he even promissed to seek appointment with the king to make a case for her desires.

A few years go by, and thus it finally arrived the day that Duke Gamelon, with Maya right on his heels... 

...stood in front of the king and the council to convey his niece's hopes and aspirations.

After much discussion an impasse was reached, in great part due to archbishop Ivan stern objections against the proposition... 

Thus the lords of the council postponed their decision until the next day, as the matter was of unprecedent nature.

'Blasphemy!', some councilmen barked in the dimly lit room. 

'Arrogance!', 'Sedition!', others parroted, all drunk on their own snobbery, for the group was biased from the start.

And so archbishop Ivan laid bare a furtive plot as he had the entire council under his dominion. 

He could easily pull the strings of those with a rotten heart in order to put in motion his nefarious machinations.
The next day, the council reconvened and delivered their response to the duke and his niece, explaining the condition that needed to be fulfilled in order to grant their request.

A pilgrimage to the ruins of an ancient empire, rumored to be the progenitors of the Magnartan royal line. 

Maya would prove her valor by braving these dangerous ruins and acquiring a holy artifact.

Try as he might, the duke was unable to dissuade his niece as she readily prepared for the perilous quest... 

 ...and the council had already arranged for her transportation on a merchant ship.

In the end the duke simply surrendered to his niece stuborness, and all he could do was to send someone to accompany Maya... 

 ...Sophie, the fairy-maid who served his family for years would guide Maya on her journey.

So it was that for the better part of a week, the ship calmly sailed towards its destination, carrying a hidden pair of maidens under its frame. 

But when the voyage reached the 7th day of sailing, dusk brought about ill tidings on the horizon, as a swarm of colossal dark clouds marched towards the ship.
Maya and Sophie could only brace themselves for the coming storm, unsure of whether this was simply a passing phenomenon, or the warning of much sinister things to come...
